messages:
Alex: FYI handoff for the Saturday night release (prod). Scheduled window: Sat 02:00-04:00 UTC. Leaving notes + watchers below. Please ack and swap if you need coverage.
Maria: ack, I can take primary watch from 01:30->03:30 UTC.
Sandeep: quick question — is the DB migration in this deploy online or offline? need to know expected downtime.
Alex: migration is online but does a rolling schema update; we expect a ~30s table lock on small tables, should be fine but flagging as risk. No full downtime.
Ryan: I can do fallback/watch duty 03:00->05:00 UTC. If we need a rollback, who's owner?
Alex: rollback owner is me until 04:00, then Ryan. Rollback plan is in the runbook: https://runbooks.internal/release/weekend-sat-02
Alex: key points:
- freeze window: code freeze from Fri 22:00 UTC to Sat 06:00 UTC (no non-critical merges)
- critical-only exceptions via @alex or @maria
- expected risky area: redis session schema change + small DB migration (monitor queries)
- rollout watchers: Maria (primary), Ryan (secondary), Sandeep (db checks)
Maria: noted. I'll watch slow queries dashboard and error rates.
Sandeep: what alert thresholds should I care about for the migration?
Alex: set alerts:
- p99 latency > 300ms for app-api => escalate
- DB lock wait > 5s on migration tables => page oncall
- error rate spike > 2x baseline 5m -> notify in thread
Alex: deploy commands (run from bastion):
```
deployctl release --env prod --version v3.7.1 --migrate --watch
```
Alex: preflight checklist (short):
- confirm canary in us-east-1 passed 30m ago
- snapshot DB and mark restore point (db-team handled)
- verify autoscaling policy for worker pool (no quota issues)
Ryan: Canary passed, logs looked clean. I validated worker autoscale config earlier.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment created by Alex for 2026-06-14T02:00:00Z - watchers: maria, ryan, sandeep. (Reminder set for 01:15 UTC)
Maria: small ask — can someone ping code-review on the 2 PRs that touch session migration? I left comments but they need final approval.
Alex: Pinged @eng-platform via PR comment. Also, @sre-alerts should be quiet-window aware.
Sandeep: I'll run quick dry-run on staging migration tonight at 23:00 my time and post results here.
Alex: thanks. If anyone needs to swap watch windows: call it out now so we can update the schedule.
Ryan: swapping with Maria for first hour? (I take 01:30->02:30)
Maria: sure, accepted. Updated my calendar.
Alex: updated watchers: Ryan primary 01:30->02:30, Maria primary 02:30->03:30, Ryan secondary 03:30->05:00, Sandeep DB checks throughout.
Maria: one more thing — please add runbook snippet to channel bookmarks: https://runbooks.internal/release/weekend-sat-02#runbook
Alex: done.
Sandeep: dry-run complete: no lock waits >2s, CPU spike ~10% for 2m, no errors. Posting staging logs to the gist: https://gist.internal/sandeep/staging-mig-001
Alex: excellent. I'll be online from 01:00-04:00 UTC. If anything odd happens, escalate to pager and ping this thread.
Ryan: thanks. I'll be reachable on phone and slack.
Maria: 👍 good to go.
Alex: closing handoff note — leaving contact info: pager: +1-555-0102, mobile: +1-555-0199. See you all in the watchers thread during window.
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-06-14T01:15:00Z (45 minutes before deployment).
